 “I never got that good.”
 Meg Walters Sat, October 24, 2026 at 2:04 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Credit: Getty The Gist
 Prince William recalled how he once wanted to be a DJ.
 He also shared his funny DJ name.
 William was the first royal to appear on The Graham Norton Show .
 Prince William once had a very different alter ego. During a rare TV appearance on The Graham Norton Show on October 23, the prince revealed that he once attempted to embark on a DJ career—complete with a hilarious DJ name.
 "I went through a phase where I wanted to be a DJ, which didn't go very well," he confessed. "And I came up with a name. I was called 'DJ Xara' with an X."
 Prince William in October 2026. 
 Credit: Getty 
 He added that his brief DJ career "wasn't good."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "It rapidly became very uncool," he continued. "I never got that good."
 Prince William in 2001. 
 Credit: Getty 
 And DJing wasn't the only career William toyed with .
 "I did want to be a policeman when I was younger," he said. "I thought I could make a good one."
 William, who was the first royal to appear on Graham Norton , also shared another insight into his private life during the interview, opening up about his family's favorite TV show: The Celebrity Traitors . Apparently, Princess Charlotte and Prince Louis love it. "I love it, the family love it," he said. "Charlotte and Louis are obsessed with it. It's really good telly."
 Prince William in 2001. 
 Credit: Getty 
 The prince also revealed that, while his DJing dreams may not have worked out, he still loves listening to music. He also enjoys a good film. "I love getting immersed in deep-thinking films," he said. "I like action films, too, but I like something a bit different. I'm a big fan of everything Christopher Nolan does. His films are fantastic— The Dark Knight series is psychologically dark and deep, and I absolutely love that. He takes concepts that are completely out there and makes them incredibly entertaining."
